source: Harmonic fit to 2026 predicted levels: Maritime Safety Queensland Brisbane Bar tide gauge (station 046046A), CC BY 4.0, data.qld.gov.au
datum: Queensland Port Datum (LAT), metres above datum, as the gauge reports
note: Fitted by scripts/tide-analysis.js from the predicted 10-minute levels, not read from a published tidal-planes table; HAT and LAT are the extremes of the fitted tide over 19 years without nodal corrections. Only heights relative to MSL are used by the tide scripts.
